title: Paretopilot: Global Optimization Reasoning on HLS Design Space Exploration with LLMs
extraction_scope: Read-only README, entry point, HLS utility, selected sampling lines, configuration and AES Tcl; no execution or headline reproduction

official_program_observations: The official DAC description frames ParetoPilot as an automated HLS design-space exploration framework using a dedicated LLM, directive scheduling and quality awareness to shape Pareto fronts.
It reports 49.5% better DSE performance and 1.8x efficiency versus a state-of-the-art heuristic, plus an 81.4% improvement over an auxiliary DeepSeek-R1 configuration.
The official page does not define DSE performance, Pareto-front aggregation, benchmark/device conditions, total search budget, model cost, correctness gate or end-to-end hardware boundary.
repository_observations: The pinned repository contains an HLS DSE workflow, benchmark and dataset directories, configuration, and source utilities, but requires a local Vitis HLS installation or API/Hugging Face model configuration.

The README names supported projects including AES, GEMM, DFT, FIR, matrix multiplication and sorting, but does not itself bind those projects to the headline comparison or disclose the reported trial logs.
The artifact entry point and inspected utility expose synthesis-estimate parsing and trial cleanup; no execution or headline reproduction was performed in this recheck.
current_source_recheck.full_text_status: No target manuscript was recovered; the public artifact remains the available non-description source.
current_source_recheck.interpretation: The recheck strengthens artifact availability and the distinction between source-exposed workflow and paper-level headline conditions. The reported percentages remain withheld pending identity, experiment, budget and independent-review reconciliation.

identity.excluded_collision: The differently titled ParetoPilot diffusion optimization paper is not this HLS paper.

artifact.search: One llm_sampling_with_metadata call precedes the synthesis loop; at most init_samples configurations are evaluated. Measured results are not fed back into another sampling call in this function.
artifact.metrics: Average-caseLatency and BRAM/DSP/FF/LUT usage fractions from csynth XML; synthesis estimates, not measured board performance or physical chip area.

example_platform.action: csynth_design; no simulation command in this inspected script

artifact.failure_handling: Missing latency/utilization becomes 1e8 for both in the entry point. The HLS utility deletes the trial project and Vitis log after parsing.
artifact.execution_cautions: Sampling can load Hugging Face code with trust_remote_code=True or invoke a configured API. Timeout cleanup kills processes by executable name. No dependencies, models, synthesis jobs or external code were run.
